characters.name: MARI
characters.description: Väike inimene, rõõmsameelne tüdruk, heledad juuksed patsidega, seljas roosa pluus ja sinised traksipüksid. Suured naeratavad silmad ja sõbralik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ELIISE
characters.description: Väike inimene, energiline tüdruk, tumedad lühikesed juuksed, seljas kollane T-särk ja rohelised lühikesed püksid. Rõõmsameelne ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: LINNAPARK
locations.description: A bright and sunny city park playground on a warm spring day. It features a large wooden sandbox with clean, light-colored sand in the foreground. In the background, there's a colorful red and yellow slide, green grass, and blooming trees with light green leaves. The sky is clear blue with a few fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style, cheerful atmosphere.

pages.scene: Mari and Eliise stand together at the edge of a large wooden sandbox in a sunny city park playground. Mari has light hair in pigtails, wearing a pink blouse and blue overalls. Eliise has short dark hair, wearing a yellow T-shirt and green shorts. They both smile brightly, looking at the sandbox. In the background, there's a colorful red and yellow slide, green grass, and blooming trees with light green leaves. The sky is clear blue with a few fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mari and Eliise are now inside the large wooden sandbox, kneeling in the clean, light-colored sand. Mari points excitedly at the sand with one hand. Eliise holds a small red plastic shovel. They both look curious and happy. The colorful red and yellow slide, green grass, and blooming trees are visible in the background, under a clear blue sky. Cartoon style.

Mari and Eliise are kneeling inside the large wooden sandbox, surrounded by a lot of clean, light-colored sand. Mari uses a small blue plastic shovel to scoop sand into a pile. Eliise is patting down a small mound of sand with her hands. They are both focused and cheerful. The park background with the colorful slide and blooming trees is consistent. Cartoon style.

Mari is kneeling inside the wooden sandbox, carefully forming a base for a sandcastle with her hands. She is concentrated but smiling. Eliise watches her with interest, holding a small red plastic bucket. There are already some small piles of sand around them. The park background with the slide and trees is consistent. Cartoon style.

Eliise is walking towards the sandbox from a short distance, holding a full small blue plastic bucket of water. Mari is still kneeling in the sandbox, continuing to shape the sandcastle base. The sandcastle base is slightly more formed now. The park background, including the slide and trees, is consistent. Cartoon style.

Mari and Eliise are both kneeling inside the sandbox, working together on a growing sandcastle. Mari is carefully adding wet sand to build up a tall wall. Eliise is pouring a little water from her small blue bucket onto the sand to make it firm. They are focused and collaborating, smiling at each other. The park background is consistent. Cartoon style.

Eliise is carefully placing a small, colorful toy flag (a red flag on a stick) on the very top of the tall, impressive sandcastle. Mari watches her with a big smile and claps her hands lightly. The finished sandcastle, with its walls and towers, is clearly visible in the foreground. The park background is consistent. Cartoon style.

Mari and Eliise stand proudly next to their completed, beautiful sandcastle in the sandbox. The sandcastle has intricate walls, towers, and a colorful flag on top. They both have big, happy smiles and are looking admiringly at their creation. The park background is consistent. Cartoon style.

pages.text: MARI JA ELIISE ON NÜÜD RÕÕMSAD.
pages.scene: Mari and Eliise are high-fiving each other happily, standing next to their magnificent sandcastle. They are both beaming with pride and joy, looking at each other. The sandcastle is fully visible in the foreground, and the sunny park background remains consistent. Cartoon style.
